commandsRun.summary: Review-only: no shell/test commands executed; all evidence from direct source reads and targeted greps (main-content hits, aria-label wiring, lightbox/focus handling, theme button outline).

validationOutput: grep confirmed id="main-content" only on src/pages/[lang]/index.astro:29; Layout.astro:57 skip link targets it.
grep confirmed slider.ariaLabel defined in i18n/content.ts but never passed to BeforeAfterSlider.astro; runtime aria-label lookup via closest('[aria-label]') finds nothing on story page.

Hand-computed ratios: white/#ff7040 2.75:1, white/#d45828 4.0:1, #d45828/#201c18 4.2:1, on-surface-variant/60 on background 3.0:1, primary/80 on background 4.4:1.
residualRisks: Contrast ratios hand-computed from tokens; re-verify solnedgang/kull CTAs and footer copyright with axe/Lighthouse on rendered themes before release.
BeforeAfterSlider exposes role/tabindex/aria only via JS; SSR-side attributes would survive bundle failure.
No automated a11y tooling exists in the repo, so these regressions have no test net.
Hero white text over photo depends on the actual image content; verify scrim strength against brightest region.
Lightbox caption is 85% white over arbitrary image content; verify contrast or add backing.

childReport.manualNotes: Review-only per instructions; no files modified, no tests run. Good foundations worth keeping: global :focus-visible rule, skip-link placement, landmark/heading structure, button-vs-link choices, reduced-motion coverage, localized alt text. Worst systemic risks: theme system ships 8 themes with unvalidated token contrast (solnedgang/kull fail hard), and the lightbox/theme-panel/slider widget JS has no focus management. Recommend adding axe-core CI before these regressions become permanent.
